story.fullStory:
The Cardigans's "Lovefool" — original release 1996. "Lovefool" is a song written by Peter Svensson and Nina Persson for Swedish rock band the Cardigans' third studio album, First Band on the Moon (1996).

It was released as the album's lead single on 10 August 1996 in Japan.

In the United States, the song was serviced to radio two days later.
